ycoss:125.long_description: Rentobo is a new tool built for landlords, managers, and agents of all sizes to simplify the process of finding and signing a new tenant for your rental property. Enter your listing details once at Rentobo and we will help you promote your property across major rental search sites. Rentobo organizes rental applications, credit scores, and social networks into an easy to use tenant profile - everything you need to make a decision. Tenants use Rentobo to sign their lease and submit their deposit electronically. Combined with online applications you can stop pushing paper. For more information, please visit us at: http://www.rentobo.com
ycoss:125.metadata_document: Rentobo is a Y Combinator company. It participated in the Summer 2011 batch, in 2011. Its status is inactive. Its stage is early. Y Combinator lists its industry as Real Estate and Construction. Its sub-industry is Real Estate and Construction within Housing and Real Estate. Additional listed industries: Housing and Real Estate. Y Combinator source tags: Marketplace, Real Estate. It is located in San Francisco, CA, USA. Listed regions: United States of America, America / Canada. Its team size is 11. It launched in 2012.

ycoss:22983.long_description: Homebase provides Rent-To-Own real estate financing for buyers in Southeast Asia - the only alternative to inflexible/high-interest rate (12%+) mortgages in the region. We strive to provide more innovative, compelling, and empathetic solutions for those who aspire to own a home. Homebase was founded in 2019 in Singapore and is backed by Y Combinator, VinaCapital Ventures, Class 5 Global, Pegasus Technology Ventures, 1982 Ventures, Iterative VC and Antler, as well as the founders and executives at disruptive real estate financing companies including Opendoor, Zerodown, 99.co and Divvy Homes.
ycoss:22983.metadata_document: Homebase is a Y Combinator company. It participated in the Winter 2021 batch, in 2021. Its status is active. Its stage is early. Y Combinator lists its industry as Real Estate and Construction. Its sub-industry is Real Estate and Construction within Housing and Real Estate. Additional listed industries: Housing and Real Estate. Y Combinator source tags: Fintech, Proptech. It is located in Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam; Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. Listed regions: Vietnam, Southeast Asia. Its team size is 20. It is currently hiring. It launched in 2021.

ycoss:246.long_description: RethinkDB is the first open-source scalable database for the realtime web. It exposes an exciting new access model -- instead of polling for changes, the developer can tell the database to continuously push updated query results to applications in realtime. RethinkDB allows developer to build scalable realtime apps in a fraction of the time with fewer engineering resources. RethinkDB features a pleasant and powerful query language that has useful queries like table joins and groupBy, a highly parallelized architecture, and web tools for managing clusters.
ycoss:246.metadata_document: RethinkDB is a Y Combinator company. It participated in the Summer 2009 batch, in 2009. Its status is acquired. Its stage is early. Y Combinator lists its industry as B2B. Its sub-industry is B2B within Infrastructure. Additional listed industries: Infrastructure. Y Combinator source tags: Open Source. It is located in San Francisco, CA, USA. Listed regions: United States of America, America / Canada. Its team size is 11. It launched in 2012.
ycoss:246.name: RethinkDB
